contexts.text: There fell upon them fearfulness and dread () = that they are devoid of any hope of domination.

I will send the hornet before thee = the dread of those who are in falsities of evil. Hornets = falsities stinging and slaying, and thus striking dread. Terror is predicated of those who are in evils; and dread, of those who are in falsities.
A great and dreadful wilderness () = grievous temptations.
Those who are in falsities, are called dreadful, etc. Illustrated.
